title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S11, the drills and Mindustrial suppliers
thread:
**Issue #3549 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3549: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S11, the drills and Mindustrial suppliers
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the drills and the cards that hand you Mindustrial cards.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #39 | Mindustrial Cross-over |
| #52 | Airblast Drill |
| #53 | Laser Drill |
| #54 | Pneumatic Drill |
| #58 | Phase Conveyer |
| #71 | Mindustrial Contract |
| #166 | Mindustrial Revolution (the list's second #140) |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E3 (#3543): Flexible.
- E4 (#3546): GIGA.
- S09 (#3547): the Minerals; and the six Stinkyscape Resources.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- "Minerals (that cost 0)" are the set's Mineral cards (#44 to #50) at cost (0). "Resources" are the six Stinkyscape Resources and the Warhero Token.
- #52 Airblast Drill: "Fill your hand" adds cards until the hand is full (`HAND_LIMIT`).
- #53 Laser Drill: GIGA once (the list says it twice on the Radiant face).
- #39 Mindustrial Cross-over: "Starpiece" means Starship Piece.
- #166 Mindustrial Revolution: renumbered from the second #140 (SP5).

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(1) Mindustrial Cross-over, Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #39**
**Discover** a random **Mindustrial Unit,** give it **Starpiece** & **Equip**
~~~
**Discover** a random **Radiant** **Mindustrial Unit,** give it **Starpiece** & **Equip,** it costs (1) less

**(4) Airblast Drill, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #52**
**GIGA**
**Tribute 1**
**End of turn:** Fill your hand with random **Minerals** (that cost 0) and **Resources**
~~~
**GIGA**
**Tribute 1**
**End of turn:** Fill your hand with random **Radiant** **Minerals** (that cost 0) and **Radiant** **Resources**

**(4) Laser Drill, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #53**
**GIGA**
**End of turn:** Add three random **Minerals** (that cost 0) or **Resources** to your hand
~~~
**GIGA**
**GIGA**
**End of turn:** Add three random **Radiant** **Minerals** (that cost 0) or **Radiant** **Resources** to your hand

**(2) Pneumatic Drill, Field Spell, Mindustrial, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #54**
**End of turn:** Add a random **Minerals** or **Resources** to your hand
~~~
**End of turn:** Add a random **Radiant** **Minerals** or **Radiant** **Resources** to your hand

**(1) Phase Conveyer, Unit, Mindustrial, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #58**
**Flexible**
0/3
**Start of turn:** add a **Mineral** and **Resource** to your hand
~~~
**Flexible**
0/6
**Start of turn:** add a **Radiant** **Mineral** and a **Radiant** **Resource** to your hand

**(1) Mindustrial Contract, Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #71**
Add 3 random **Mindustrial** cards to your hand
~~~
Add 3 random **Radiant Mindustrial** cards to your hand

**(2) Mindustrial Revolution, Spell, Mindustrial, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #140**
For the rest of the game at the start of your turn add a random **Mindustrial** card to your hand
~~~
For the rest of the game at the start of your turn add a random **Radiant Mindustrial** card to your hand, it costs (1) less
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3546, #3547

Part of #3534.
````
